listing.name: Muppet RaceMania — RustMania Racing (Ray-m-w)
listing.summary: The project reports native 60 Hz widescreen, tick comparisons and HUD reference checks. Full campaign completion has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS01237 CUE/BIN and follow the documented CHD conversion if needed. The game digest is checked.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release or follow the source build. Keep your disc available; its assets are read during play.
